items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: Yeah, that's one of them started with Buck. That's right. And that's from Johnson time.

ctx.x: wrap around here or just an upright tuba? No. Upright tuba. Is it B flat or E flat? E flat tuba. E flat. Well that's, that's an E flat tuba. Oh is that E flat? Yeah that's an E flat up there. I thought most of the big things, Pelican and Suzy Phones were B flat. But that's an E flat. Yeah. That's all you ever played in the E flat tuba. I didn't know.

Nah, I used to hit it too. Yeah, sounds good. You know I used to play for you. Yeah, you hit a couple of records for me. Yeah. I played the bass tuba with you and uh, and slow drag played the bass tuba. Yeah, that's one of them started with Buck. That's right. And that's from Johnson time.
1944 over at San Jacinto Hall. Yeah, that's right. That was a pretty good time wasn't it Bill? Yeah.
